spans.s: patr. fr. जे॑मन्, Pravar. iv, 1 and vi, 3 (v.l.)

N. of a celebrated sage and philosopher (he was a pupil of Vyāsa [who made over to him the SV.; BhP. i, 4, 21; VāyuP.] SāmavBr.; MBh. i f., xii; and was Udgātṛ priest at Janamejaya's snake-sacrifice, i, 2046; and was founder of the Pūrva- or Karma-Mīmāṃsā, Pañcat.; Madhus.), ĀśvGṛ. iii, 4; ŚāṅkhGṛ.; Pravar. i, 4; iv, 1; Hariv.; Bādar. &c.
जैमिनि—कडार m. = कडार-जैमिनि, the red Jaimini, Pāṇ. ii, 2, 38, Kāś.
जैमिनि—भागवत n. N. of a modern revision of BhP.
जैमिनि—भारत n. N. of a modern revision of MBh.
जैमिनि—सूत्र n. N. of wk., Prauḍh.
relating to or composed by Jaimini (a Dharma-śāstra), Sarvad. xii, 19
an adherent of Jaimini, SŚaṃkar. xvi, 79
pl. N. of a school of the SV.; Caraṇ.
जैमिनीय—न्याय-माला-विस्तर m. N. of a compendium of the Mīmāṃsā philosophy by Mādhava.
relating to the sage Jīmūta, MBh. v, 3845.
